description: We’re a Córdoba-based team of programmers at different stages: a 3rd-year CS student (C/C++, Linux, HPC), a 1st-year CS student, a high school programming student, and a final-year software technician. We’re eager to learn and build something real with NASA data. Looking for: data analysis/ML, UI/web design, GIS or remote sensing, and someone with a science background (physics, biology, earth science). All levels welcome!
